behavior.exact_fallback: If any original coordinate is subnormal or has biased exponent 1..24, or any computed edge is nonfinite, expands each 2D determinant into six exact products from original coordinates and compares positive/negative 576-bit limb sums.
behavior.fast_path: Uses FMA product residuals only when both residuals are finite and normal. Uses exact integer product comparison when the residual is zero, subnormal, or nonfinite.
behavior.gate: The existing nonfinite float-cross check remains first and rejecting; exact-zero logic does not make overflowing area vectors admissible.
